fields.name: Cobra Stance
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you.
After the attack: You may swap with a :smoke_bomb_token: Smoke bomb in radius; if you do, you may place the Smoke bomb into a space in radius.

fields.name: Dragon Stance
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you.
After the attack: You may move 1 or 2 spaces to a space adjacent to the target. Push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 3 spaces.

fields.name: Holy Death Grenade

fields.name: Minefield

fields.name: Perfect Self
fields.effect_text:
Choose one, or both —
• This round: Double your item bonuses.
• Take a Tier II card from your deck and add it to your dashboard as a permanent item.

fields.effect_text: Swap with a :smoke_bomb_token: Smoke bomb in range; if you do, block the attack. You may place the Smoke bomb into a space in range.

fields.name: Viper Stance
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you.
After the attack: You may swap with a :smoke_bomb_token: Smoke bomb in radius.

fields.name: Tiger Stance
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you.

fields.name: Death Grenade

fields.name: Cluster Mine
fields.effect_text: Place 3 Mine tokens, 1 :blast_token: blast and 2 :dud_token: duds, facedown in radius; units may move through them; remove mine tokens after an enemy hero moves through them; for every blast removed, that hero discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Inner Strength
fields.effect_text: This round: Double your item bonuses.

fields.name: Crane Stance
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit adjacent to you.

fields.name: Trip Mine

fields.name: Poof!
